Ходы под южными лугами Пронтеры. Муравьи: Tunnels beneath the Prontera South Fields. Ants drag into their burrows everything travelers drop.
Beneath the archers' village, the dead don't sleep. Skeletons guard the weapons of fallen hunters.
Гробницы древних царей в песках. Мумии х: Tombs of ancient kings in the sands. Mummies keep the robes and staves of Osiris's priests.
Шестерни всё ещё крутятся, а в подвалах: The gears still turn, and Mimics hide in the cellars with adventurers' loot.
Под лапами Сфинкса — лабиринт с ловушкам: Beneath the Sphinx's paws lies a trapped maze. Sandmen guard the pharaohs' treasures.
Лисьи огни водят путников по бамбуковой: Fox fires lead travelers through the bamboo thicket. Whoever reaches the altar leaves with gifts.
Полузатопленный фрегат у Излуда. В трюма: A half-sunken frigate off Izlude. Its holds are full of chests the dead won't give up for free.
Проклятый замок рыцарей на холме. Мёртвы: A cursed knights' castle on a hill. The dead watch still changes by the rules, and in the armory rust swords no one is left to lift.
Лес у самой Пронтеры, где тропы меняются: A forest right by Prontera where paths shift and hollows whisper deals. Stay near the edge — and sign nothing.
Туманная река на краю Нифльхейма. Души з: A misty river at the edge of Niflheim. Souls of forgotten warriors wander with weapons they no longer need.
